name: rednote-downloader
description: 小红书内容下载器 — Chrome 扩展

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.pretest: esbuild tests/core.test.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/test/core.test.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild tests/downloader.test.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/test/downloader.test.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild tests/self-engine.test.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/test/self-engine.test.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild src/background/downloader.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/test/_downloader.mjs --log-level=error
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/e2e.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch.mjs && node scripts/e2e-self.mjs
